parsed.evidence_sentence: Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner conducts an in-person or Medicare-approved telehealth visit with the beneficiary to document adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.
parsed.explanation: The revised policy contains the exact same requirement as the existing rule: a follow-up visit every six months to document adherence to the CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan. The wording is unchanged and the requirement is still present.
